'''Waldo''', a native of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core world]] of [[Mamendin]], was the [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] security expert of the [[Slams|Slam gang]].

In [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], in an attempt to apprehend [[Jenna Zan Arbor]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] took on the identity of Waldo while serving [[Mission to Romin|undercover]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Romin]].<ref name="JQ:CotG" />
